scope: Reviewed the Japanese article and all twelve translations for service description, prices, PV ticket limits and counting, domain/font limits, dates, and links against the current official site.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates, preserved the original publication date, and set lastmod to the review date.
Corrected the obsolete flat-price claim: Smart License is usage-ticket based, starting at JPY 1,100 for 100,000 PV/one month; 1.2 million PV/year is JPY 13,200 including tax.
Clarified trial limits, unlimited domains/font count as listed, reload/script-tag PV counting, and custom-plan quotes.
Added the official pricing page to all locales.
